title: Atlantean survivors may live among us, with underwater or lunar bases

tellings.quote: Ah, now there's the loaded question, Jesse. I will just say very provisional. Yes.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels asks a researcher, Randall Carlson, whether survivors of Atlantis, the legendary lost civilisation, might still live among us, perhaps in bases under the sea or on the Moon. Carlson calls it a loaded question and answers that, very provisionally, yes. If true, it would mean an advanced lineage has stayed hidden from the rest of humanity since ancient times.
